description: Answer. Note. Book. A virtual receptionist demo for Scriptable on iPhone: call a dental clinic, Reva screens you by voice, and you book the visit as the front desk. AI is optional, with your own Claude or OpenAI key.

install.kept: Your patients, calls and settings are kept.
install.firstRun: Tap Call to ring the demo clinic; for a real conversation, add a Claude or OpenAI key in Settings › AI settings.
